data.description:
## Problem

The Node capture-side series exporter (`extractActionIntensitySeriesFromRecords` in `scripts/capture-series.mjs`) assigns each retained sample `t = samples.length * gridMs` (100 ms at 10 Hz) instead of deriving time from the telemetry record. Consecutive samples whose metric values are identical are collapsed, so the exported `t` axis compresses whenever the metric is unchanged between grid steps.

Evidence from the C6 capture pool (AH-0MVDV4SYG008X8TY):

- Run `gameplay-2026-10-19T16-51-02-526Z`: capture reports `runLengthMs: 110457` and the series' last record carries `tick: 739`.
- Exported series `gameplay-2026-10-19T16-51-02-526Z.action.jsonl`: 440 samples, last sample `t = 43900` — i.e. the timeline claims 43.9 s although the run was ~110 s.
- Boss runs show the same pattern (e.g. 54.9 s clip, 90 samples, series horizon 8.9 s).

Impact: §7.5 video-join maps a series time to video time via `videoTimeMs(t) = t − offsetMs`. A compressed `t` axis therefore maps selected peaks to the wrong video position. The promo compiler's selection manifest (parent AC2, C7 AH-0MVDV50Z20071RF4) claims "mapped video timestamps" for each pick, so this undermines the verifiability requirement.

## Expected behaviour

- The exported series `t` must represent real time since run start (within the documented sample grid) for every retained sample, even when consecutive metric values are identical.
- Either derive `t` from the telemetry record's own clock/tick (with a documented tick→ms conversion) or emit a sample per grid step instead of collapsing the timeline.
- Update `docs/dev/action-intensity.md` §7.2/§7.5 if the contract changes, and add a regression test with a run longer than the collapsed sample count.

## References

- `scripts/capture-series.mjs` — `extractActionIntensitySeriesFromRecords`
- `src/scenes/core/actionIntensitySerialiser.ts` — `t` contract ("milliseconds since run start")
- `docs/dev/action-intensity.md` §7.2–§7.5
- Discovered while gathering footage: AH-0MVDV4SYG008X8TY
- Blocks accurate selection manifests: AH-0MVDV50Z20071RF4
